$code = @"
import asyncio, csv, os, sys, time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
sys.path.insert\(0, "/app/backend"\)
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert as pg_insert
from app.database import async_session_factory
from app.models.team import Team
from app.models.game import Game
from app.models.team_game_stats import TeamGameStats

KAGGLE = "/home/appuser/.cache/kagglehub/datasets/nathanlauga/nba-games/versions/10"

def si\(v, d=None\):
    if v is None or v == "": return d
    try: return int\(float\(v\)\)
    except: return d

async def run\(\):
    t0 = time.monotonic\(\)
    team_map = {}
    async with async_session_factory\(\) as sess:
        r = await sess.execute\(select\(Team\)\)
        for t in r.scalars\(\).all\(\):
            team_map[t.nba_team_id] = t.id
    print\(f"Team map: {len\(team_map\)}"\)

    count, skipped = 0, 0
    batch = []
    async with async_session_factory\(\) as sess:
        with open\(os.path.join\(KAGGLE, "games.csv"\), "r", encoding="utf-8"\) as f:
            for row in csv.DictReader\(f\):
                hid = team_map.get\(si\(row.get\("HOME_TEAM_ID"\)\)\)
                aid = team_map.get\(si\(row.get\("VISITOR_TEAM_ID"\)\)\)
                if not hid or not aid: continue
                ds = row.get\("GAME_DATE_EST", ""\)
                try: gd = datetime.strptime\(ds[:10], "%Y-%m-%d"\)
                except ValueError: continue
                batch.append\(dict\(
                    gid=row["GAME_ID"], season=row.get\("SEASON",""\),
                    date=gd, hid=hid, aid=aid,
                    status=row.get\("GAME_STATUS_TEXT", "Final"\),
                    hs=si\(row.get\("PTS_home"\)\), aw=si\(row.get\("PTS_away"\)\),
                    hr=si\(row.get\("REB_home"\),0\), ha=si\(row.get\("AST_home"\),0\),
                    hstl=si\(row.get\("STL_home"\),0\), hblk=si\(row.get\("BLK_home"\),0\),
                    htov=si\(row.get\("TOV_home"\),0\), hpf=si\(row.get\("PF_home"\),0\),
                    hfgm=si\(row.get\("FGM_home"\),0\), hfga=si\(row.get\("FGA_home"\),0\),
                    hfg3m=si\(row.get\("FG3M_home"\),0\), hfg3a=si\(row.get\("FG3A_home"\),0\),
                    hftm=si\(row.get\("FTM_home"\),0\), hfta=si\(row.get\("FTA_home"\),0\),
                    ar=si\(row.get\("REB_away"\),0\), aa=si\(row.get\("AST_away"\),0\),
                    astl=si\(row.get\("STL_away"\),0\), ablk=si\(row.get\("BLK_away"\),0\),
                    atov=si\(row.get\("TOV_away"\),0\), apf=si\(row.get\("PF_away"\),0\),
                    afgm=si\(row.get\("FGM_away"\),0\), afga=si\(row.get\("FGA_away"\),0\),
                    afg3m=si\(row.get\("FG3M_away"\),0\), afg3a=si\(row.get\("FG3A_away"\),0\),
                    aftm=si\(row.get\("FTM_away"\),0\), afta=si\(row.get\("FTA_away"\),0\)\)\)
                if len\(batch\) >= 500:
                    for g in batch:
                        rr = await sess.execute\(select\(Game.id\).where\(Game.nba_game_id == g["gid"]\)\)
                        if rr.scalar_one_or_none\(\): skipped += 1; continue
                        rr2 = await sess.execute\(pg_insert\(Game\).values\(
                            nba_game_id=g["gid"], season=g["season"],
                            game_date=g["date"], home_team_id=g["hid"],
                            away_team_id=g["aid"], status=g["status"],
                            home_score=g["hs"], away_score=g["aw"]\).returning\(Game.id\)\)
                        gid_int = rr2.scalar_one\(\)
                        for is_h, tid, pts, reb, ast_, stl, blk, tov, pf, fgm, fga, fg3m, fg3a, ftm, fta in [
                            \(True, g["hid"], g["hs"], g["hr"], g["ha"], g["hstl"], g["hblk"],
                             g["htov"], g["hpf"], g["hfgm"], g["hfga"], g["hfg3m"], g["hfg3a"],
                             g["hftm"], g["hfta"]\),
                            \(False, g["aid"], g["aw"], g["ar"], g["aa"], g["astl"], g["ablk"],
                             g["atov"], g["apf"], g["afgm"], g["afga"], g["afg3m"], g["afg3a"],
                             g["aftm"], g["afta"]\)]:
                            await sess.execute\(TeamGameStats.__table__.insert\(\).values\(
                                game_id=gid_int, team_id=tid, is_home=is_h,
                                pts=pts or 0, reb=reb, ast=ast_, stl=stl, blk=blk,
                                tov=tov, pf=pf, fgm=fgm, fga=fga,
                                fg3m=fg3m, fg3a=fg3a, ftm=ftm, fta=fta\)\)
                    await sess.commit\(\)
                    count += len\(batch\)
                    elapsed = time.monotonic\(\) - t0
                    print\(f"\\r  Games: {count} new + {skipped} skipped \({count/elapsed:.0f}/s\)...", end="", flush=True\)
                    batch = []
        if batch:
            for g in batch:
                rr = await sess.execute\(select\(Game.id\).where\(Game.nba_game_id == g["gid"]\)\)
                if rr.scalar_one_or_none\(\): skipped += 1; continue
                rr2 = await sess.execute\(pg_insert\(Game\).values\(
                    nba_game_id=g["gid"], season=g["season"],
                    game_date=g["date"], home_team_id=g["hid"],
                    away_team_id=g["aid"], status=g["status"],
                    home_score=g["hs"], away_score=g["aw"]\).returning\(Game.id\)\)
                gid_int = rr2.scalar_one\(\)
                for is_h, tid, pts, reb, ast_, stl, blk, tov, pf, fgm, fga, fg3m, fg3a, ftm, fta in [
                    \(True, g["hid"], g["hs"], g["hr"], g["ha"], g["hstl"], g["hblk"],
                     g["htov"], g["hpf"], g["hfgm"], g["hfga"], g["hfg3m"], g["hfg3a"],
                     g["hftm"], g["hfta"]\),
                    \(False, g["aid"], g["aw"], g["ar"], g["aa"], g["astl"], g["ablk"],
                     g["atov"], g["apf"], g["afgm"], g["afga"], g["afg3m"], g["afg3a"],
                     g["aftm"], g["afta"]\)]:
                    await sess.execute\(TeamGameStats.__table__.insert\(\).values\(
                        game_id=gid_int, team_id=tid, is_home=is_h,
                        pts=pts or 0, reb=reb, ast=ast_, stl=stl, blk=blk,
                        tov=tov, pf=pf, fgm=fgm, fga=fga,
                        fg3m=fg3m, fg3a=fg3a, ftm=ftm, fta=fta\)\)
            await sess.commit\(\)
            count += len\(batch\)
    print\(f"\\r  Games: {count} new + {skipped} skipped \({time.monotonic\(\)-t0:.0f}s\)"\)

asyncio.run\(run\(\)\)
"@
